scope: Master data and opening PROBLEM/ALLERGY context only. No encounters, source production integration, operations, claims, forecasts or analytics.
unknown_emergency_identity: Out of scope for the named adult baseline; unknown demographic values are explicit, no temporary anonymous encounter cohort is invented.
household_guardian: No guardian/household tables required for adult baseline. Shared address is not proof of family relationship.

contact_namespaces.phone: US 555-0100 through 555-0199 within configured Illinois area codes; not unique

source_policy: Full source columns use frozen table authority; IDs differ from names. Crosswalk is an explicitly bounded alias/exception map; deterministic primary source IDs cover every person without requiring a crosswalk row per person.
bitemporal_policy: Half-open valid and known rectangles. Three-row history for an observed effective change: original known version, retrospectively closed old business segment, new business segment. Future planned contract expiration may be known before occurrence.
